name: VDPHL01
phase: Study 302 positive topline (Phase 2/3); confirmatory Phase 3 Study 304 readout planned
signal: In Study 302 (519 men; six-month topline), the sponsor reported co-primary objective non-vellus target-area hair-count changes of +30.3/+33.0 hairs/cm² for once-/twice-daily arms versus +7.3 for placebo, and co-primary AAIRS ‘improved’/‘much improved’ responses of 48.4%/62.9% versus 13.4%. The often-quoted 79.3%/86.0% versus 35.6% is the secondary patient-reported ‘any improvement’ endpoint, not hair density. As of its August 2026 update, the sponsor anticipated confirmatory Phase 3 Study 304 topline data in 2H26; no Study 304 result or approval is claimed here.
why: A sponsor-reported six-month signal in men, with patient-reported and objective hair-count outcomes kept distinct. This record does not establish durability, independent replication, or approval.
sourceStatus: sponsor-reported topline; no peer-reviewed report is linked in this record
population: Study 302: men with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss

milestones.outcome: Positive six-month topline reported by sponsor
Sponsor anticipated confirmatory topline data in the second half of 2026; no result is recorded here

objectiveHairCount.endpoint: Mean change in non-vellus target-area hair count at Month 6

patientReportedImproved.endpoint: AAIRS response of improved or much improved at Month 6

patientReportedAnyImprovement.endpoint: AAIRS response including a little improved, improved, or much improved at Month 6
patientReportedAnyImprovement.interpretation: Patient-reported hair coverage; not an objective hair-density or hair-count result

comparison.timeline: As of the sponsor’s August 11, 2026 update, confirmatory Phase 3 Study 304 topline data were expected in 2H26.
comparison.limits: Sponsor topline data; Study 302 evaluated men at six months. Study 304 confirmation, durability, independent replication, and regulatory approval are not established by these sources.
